tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions applicable as per Tender Notification

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should have Supply of 150 persons per year to the Govt/Semi Govt. But Preference will be given to bidder with experience in forest department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate as Prime Contractor should be obtained from forest divisions duly signed by an officer not below the rank of DCF/equivalent officer

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have supplied labourers to Govt/Semi Govt. atleast 150 persons per year.(a) Achieved in at least three financial years a minimum financial turnover usually double the work estimate cost.
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate (a) Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% of the ECV. (Rs.141.75 lakhs)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificates from Nationalised banks for meeting the fund requirement Credit Lines/Letter of Credit.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should be registered in Labour department, EPF, ESI, IT, GST, ISO issued by the Competent authority.
Contractors should be registered as Forest Contractor in any of the Forest Division Office for the financial year 2026-27.

The outsource Agency should upload the Notrified affidavit in respect of payment made as wage component ESI, PF and other taxes on or before 5th of every month, All extract in support of all the payment details should be uploaded. Any discrepancy in payment of wages PF, ESI and other taxes or Non uploading of document by the outsource agency shall be treated seriously and such agency shall stands rejected.
Notrified affidavit saying that the bidder is not black listed by any of the Government offices.

Bidder must submit a confirmation from the head of the office/officer not below the rank of DCF/equivalent officer where the contract was held during the previous year during 2025-26 certifying that the monthly wages of the outsourced employees, including ESI and PF contributions, have been paid in full and that no dues are outstanding.
